**Have you checked `docs/ROADMAP.md`?** Many gaps are already scoped there under "Scoped, not yet
built," and some questions are already recorded as deliberate decisions under "Decided" — check
both before filing, since the answer might already be written down.

**Is this a new formatting vocabulary entry** (a new inline style, block type, table, code block,
nested list, etc.)? If so, read `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`'s Vocabulary section first — the small,
closed vocabulary is a deliberate design constraint, not an oversight, and a request to expand it
needs to address why the round-trip/cross-platform-consistency guarantee still holds, not just
what the feature would look like.
